input.question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?
input.ground_truth: because they're considered irrelevant by our brains. you can train yourself in recollection. that's done mostly by writing down any shreds you do remember, as quickly as you can after you've had the dream.

Question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine your brain is like a little box where you keep your toys (which are your memories). When you sleep, your brain plays with lots of fun pictures and stories, like a movie just for you—that’s your dream!

But when you wake up, your brain is like, “Oh! Time to get ready for the day!” and it forgets to put the dream toys in the memory box. That’s why it’s so hard to remember your dreams when you wake up. They just kind of float away before you can grab them!

It’s like trying to catch bubbles with your hands—the bubbles are pretty, but they pop before you can hold them!
